sentences.en: On Friday evening the whole family comes.

sentences.ar: אמא מבשלת מרק ועוף עם אורז.
sentences.en: Mum cooks soup and chicken with rice.
On the table there's challah and wine.
The children run around the living room.
After the meal we drink tea.
